indicesNarrative: Equities are holding firm near record highs, spearheaded by Nasdaq tech strength and an easing in energy prices. However, with the 10-year Treasury yield trading near 5%, leadership remains concentrated in high-quality, cash-rich megacap tech rather than broad-market small caps.
technicalsNarrative: SPY and QQQ maintain rising MACD histograms with daily RSIs hovering in the high-60s, reflecting strong structural momentum. However, both major indices sit 1.4-1.6 ATRs above their 21 EMAs, placing index entry risk at EXTENDED—entries are best taken on tight intraday pivots rather than chasing index gap-ups.
